authority.rule: This ledger carries team power ratings forward for Walters fair-spread construction. It does not itself create a BET or supply executable market prices.

seed.rule: seedRating never changes. It remains provenance for where the 2026 rating lineage began.

carryForwardPolicy.rule: Every new Graham rating update starts from the team's currentRating. On update, copy currentRating to priorRating, apply an explicit delta, write the result back to currentRating, and append a history event. Never reset currentRating to seedRating merely because the original guide is old.

ratingUse.neutralDifferentialRule: For a matchup, calculate the carried neutral differential from the two teams' currentRating values before venue, personnel or game-factor adjustments.
ratingUse.venueRule: Home-field or venue value is a separate Walters adjustment and must not be buried in currentRating unless a deliberate team-rating change is being made.
ratingUse.personnelRule: Current quarterback/personnel information may justify a carried team-rating update only when the delta and evidence are recorded. Event-specific uncertainty may instead stay in the individual matchup build.
ratingUse.marketRule: Complete the independent Graham/Walters fair build before comparing with the sportsbook market.
ratingUse.espnRule: ESPN FPI is an independent comparison/model input. Because its scale differs from the VSiN/Graham scale, compare implied matchup differentials and components; never mechanically average the raw rating values.
